$comment: A page of contract text in Times, standard 14 and NOT embedded, 11 pt on 14, each line at x 72 on its baseline.
Both halves of the line end pair build the page from this file and read their answers from it: the rendered case
(packages/testing/src/lineEnds.pw.ts) hands `lines[].box` to the page as its text layer and asserts a drag's two
ends against `lines[].glyphs`; the kernel proof (scripts/proofs/lineEndMarks.proof.mjs) refuses to pass unless the
engine still reads exactly these boxes (readPageText and textLayerOf) and these glyph edges (MuPDF's character
quads, spaces skipped), so the file cannot go stale without the proof turning red.
Read 2026-10-24 with MuPDF 1.28.0 through the native engine on Linux, by `npm run proof:lineendmarks`.
The boxes were read again 2026-10-31 the same way, in hundredths: the page text is now asked for at MuPDF's
precision scale (ADR-0280's fifth correction), where on 2026-10-24 its JSON wrote them in whole points.

lines.text: This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and continue for the term of
twelve months, unless ended sooner under clause 9.
Each party may end it on notice.
